name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Serpentine Owl)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Animate
powers.text: Magic action: throw it to a spot within 60 ft: it becomes a Giant Owl for up to 8 hours, then can't be used again for 2 days.

summary: Becomes a Giant Owl that serves you for up to 8 hours (once every 2 days).
text: Small enough for a pocket, this statuette comes alive when you use a Magic action to hurl it at a spot on the ground up to 60 feet away, turning into a Giant Owl. If something already occupies that space, the transformation fails. The owl regards you and your allies as friends, knows your languages and does as you say; given no orders, it defends itself and otherwise does nothing. After up to 8 hours it becomes a figurine once more, or sooner if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points or you touch it and use a Magic action to end the transformation. Once it reverts, the figurine needs 2 days before it works again.
